title: Order confirmation emails not sent
alert: notification queue depth 52,000 and rising; customer anita.s@gmail.com got no confirmation
root cause: A deploy changed the email template id and the notifier kept failing and requeuing
fix: Rolled back the template change and drained the queue with a rate limit

title: Checkout returning 503
alert: cart-service 503 Service Unavailable during the Big Sale; redis-cart used_memory 99%
root cause: Redis cart memory filled up and evicted live cart sessions while the autoscaler added pods that opened more connections
failed fixes: Letting the autoscaler add cart-service pods
fix: Froze cart-service autoscaling, raised redis-cart maxmemory, switched eviction to volatile-lru and warmed the top 500 products

title: Shipping labels not generating
alert: logistics-bridge QuickDrop API returning 500 for label creation; 1,280 orders waiting
root cause: QuickDrop had an outage and our client retried in a tight loop
fix: Switched new shipments to the secondary courier and queued the rest with backoff

title: Product pages hanging
alert: Product pages waiting 8s on reco-service; support line 9876012345 flooded
root cause: Product pages called reco-service synchronously with no timeout
fix: Added a 300ms timeout with a circuit breaker and a static fallback list
